title: A PDE Perspective on Generative Diffusion Models
abstract: arXiv:2511.05940v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Score-based diffusion models have emerged as a powerful class of generative methods, with successful applications across diverse domains. Despite their empirical success, their mathematical foundations remain only partially understood, particularly regarding the stability and consistency of the stochastic and partial differential equations underlying their dynamics.   In this work, we develop a partial differential equation (PDE) framework for score-based diffusion processes associated with the heat flow of a compactly supported data measure. After establishing weak well-posedness on positive-time intervals, we derive a sharp one-sided divergence bound for the score and use it to obtain sharp uniform $L^p$-stability estimates for the generative Fokker--Planck equation. translated_title: 生成扩散模型的偏微分方程视角
translated_abstract: 基于分数的扩散模型已成为一类强大的生成方法，在多个领域均取得了成功的应用。尽管其在实践中表现优异，但其数学基础至今仍仅被部分理解，尤其是其动力学背后的随机偏微分方程与偏微分方程的稳定性和一致性问题。在本工作中，我们为与紧支撑数据测度的热流相关联的基于分数的扩散过程建立了一个偏微分方程（PDE）框架。在建立正时间区间上的弱适定性之后，我们推导出分数的一个尖锐的单侧散度界，并利用它获得了生成Fokker–Planck方程的尖锐一致 $L^p$ 稳定性估计。该界是Li–Yau微分不等式的欧几里得形式。通过熵稳定性方法，我们证明了生成分布以 2-（Wasserstein 距离）收敛……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文为与紧支撑数据测度热流相关的分数扩散模型建立了偏微分方程框架，通过推导出分数的尖锐单侧散度界（即Li–Yau微分不等式的欧氏形式）证明了生成Fokker–Planck方程的尖锐一致 $L^p$ 稳定性估计，并借助熵稳定性方法证明了生成分布的收敛性。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a PDE framework for score-based diffusion processes associated with the heat flow of compactly supported data measures, deriving a sharp one-sided divergence bound for the score—the Euclidean form of the Li–Yau differential inequality—which yields sharp uniform $L^p$-stability estimates for the generative Fokker–Planck equation, and proving convergence of the generated laws through entropy stability methods.
